title: Book Three · Chapter 85: Anna's Third Saturday
story:
The next day, Ronan tells Anna about Leo's longer visit.

“Three weeks,” he says. “At the start of the holiday.”

Anna smiles. “Then we may see him more than once.”

She takes a folded notice from her notebook. There is a drawing of a building at the top.

“I have something for the holiday too.”

The local art centre has arranged a visit to a design studio across town. A guide will meet the group outside the main library. Then they will take a local bus together.

“The third Saturday,” Anna says. “Nine at the library. The group leaves at a quarter past.”

Ronan looks at the day. It will be Leo's third Saturday in town too.

“Lin is visiting her grandmother that weekend,” Anna says. “Would you come with me?”

“To see the models?”

“And the working room. I want to see the plans before they become buildings.”

Ronan studies the small drawing. He can understand the doorway. The lines inside look harder.

“Do we need tickets?”

“The places are free. We need our own bus money. We also need to give our names this week.”

“I would like to come.”

Anna looks pleased. She writes his name beside hers on the small reply sheet.

“At the library doors by nine?”

“I will be there.”

She puts the notice back in the notebook. Ronan writes the day and time in his own book.

At lunch, he tells Kai about the old-book idea. Kai asks if the books will have football in them.

“Some may.”

“Then don't sell those too fast.”

“You can come and look.”

Kai nods. He has family plans for part of the holiday. He cannot stand beside a book table every day.

After school, Ronan finishes the letter to Leo. He confirms the school holiday dates. He says the book idea interests him. Then he tells Leo about his other promise. He has promised Anna the third Saturday morning.

He also writes that any books need to be their own. His birthday book will stay on his shelf.

Before dinner, he sends this fifteenth letter at the post office.

At home, Mum asks about his school day. He shows her the copied visit time.

“An important morning,” she says.

“For Anna.”

“And you agreed to go.”

He nods. “I want to see it with her.”

He puts the date beside his summer notes. There is still space on the page for Leo's bus times and the book table.

Then he opens his school work. Summer has several plans now. Tonight's page still needs an answer before he can put his pen away.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

design studio＝设计工作室；guide＝带领参观的人；quarter past nine＝九点十五分；confirm＝确认。

## 理解问题

1. Anna的重要参观在假期第几个星期六？在哪里、几点集合，几点出发？
2. Ronan怎样回应邀请？他有没有把这项约定告诉Leo？

## 读句子

**He has promised Anna the third Saturday morning.**

拆开看：He / has promised Anna / the third Saturday morning.

他／已经答应Anna／把第三个星期六上午留给这项参观。
